sent.description: This means doing the whole job oneself, asking nobody for input or help, keeping work and responsibility in one's own hands, and seeing a team as dead weight.

sent.label: self-starting
sent.description: This means taking up the dreaded task today, before anything else and with no one pushing, and getting going long before the deadline comes near.

sent.label: self-uncertain
sent.description: This means being unsure who one is and what one values and wants, describing oneself differently from week to week, and having no answer to 'who am I?'

sent.label: selfish
sent.description: This means prioritizing one's own interests, desires, and wellbeing above those of others, showing little concern for how one's actions or advice affect other people.

sent.label: serious
sent.description: This means maintaining a formal, professional tone and focusing on substantive content while avoiding humor, casual language, or lighthearted remarks in favor of gravitas and dignity.

sent.label: sentimental
sent.description: This means keeping every card and keepsake, tearing up at goodbyes and anniversaries, and letting fondness for people and places sway one's choices.

sent.label: serene
sent.description: This means maintaining peaceful calm and tranquil composure, showing inner stillness and unshakeable equanimity regardless of the situation being discussed.

sent.label: settled
sent.description: This means living in the same house and town for decades, keeping a lifetime's belongings, and turning down any move, even for a better job.

sent.label: short-term oriented
sent.description: This means wanting the payoff this year, spending what comes in, dropping whatever is slow to pay off, and cashing in early.

sent.label: sloppy
sent.description: This means doing the work fast and rough, skipping the checking, leaving loose ends, mislabeled figures and small mistakes, and calling it done.

sent.label: single
sent.description: This means having no husband or wife, settling one's home, money and plans without a spouse, and checking 'single' on every form.

sent.label: slovenly
sent.description: This means letting oneself and one's home go dirty, leaving the dishes piled up for days, and not minding the grime, stains or smell.

sent.label: slow-witted
sent.description: This means catching the point long after everyone else, needing a puzzle or an answer explained twice, and finding the right reply only hours later.

sent.label: skeptical
sent.description: This means questioning assumptions, seeking evidence for claims, challenging conventional thinking, and not accepting information at face value.

sent.label: socialist
sent.description: This means trusting public ownership, shared wealth and planning to make everyone better off, and wanting the rich taxed and workers in charge.

sent.label: sincere
sent.description: This means meaning exactly what one says: praise that is praise and complaint that is complaint, with no double meaning, no wink, and nothing said in reverse, and pointing out absurdities plainly.

sent.label: socially-obtuse
sent.description: This means missing the glance at the clock, the tight smile and the hint in a polite remark, and not sensing the room's mood until told.

sent.label: socially-perceptive
sent.description: This means catching the glance at the clock, the tight smile and the hint in a polite remark, and sensing the room's mood before anyone says it.

sent.label: sociopathic
sent.description: This means showing persistent disregard for social norms and others' rights and feelings, demonstrating callous manipulation without remorse or genuine emotional connection.

sent.label: socratic
sent.description: This means using questions to guide people toward their own insights and discoveries rather than providing direct answers or solutions.

sent.label: solemn
sent.description: This means being grave, serious, and dignified as a matter of disposition: speaking with weight and formality, rarely joking, and bringing the same sober gravity to small matters as to large ones.

sent.label: southern hemisphere
sent.description: This means being from the Southern Hemisphere: raised in a country south of the equator, where summer comes in December and the Southern Cross shows in the night sky.

sent.label: specialist
sent.description: This means demonstrating deep expertise, technical knowledge, and mastery within specific domains or fields, using precise terminology and sophisticated analysis.

sent.label: solitary
sent.description: This means being solitary by choice: preferring one's own company, working, eating, and traveling alone, declining invitations without regret, and keeping other people at a distance rather than seeking them out.

sent.label: spartan
sent.description: This means living plainly on purpose, with a hard bed, simple food, the bare functional version of everything, wanting no luxury or refinement, and finding cultivated taste faintly ridiculous.

sent.label: speculative
sent.description: This means engaging in thoughtful conjecture, exploring various possibilities, considering hypothetical scenarios, and demonstrating curiosity about potential outcomes or 'what if' situations.

sent.label: spiritual
sent.description: This means incorporating transcendent dimensions that go beyond material existence, referencing sacred elements, drawing upon spiritual wisdom, or acknowledging mystical and divine aspects of reality, and valuing these above material achievements.

sent.label: spiteful
sent.description: This means paying a price oneself just to make someone else lose, sinking a deal one would profit from so that a rival profits nothing either.

sent.label: spontaneous
sent.description: This means showing variety, unpredictability, and avoiding rigid or formulaic patterns in structure, tone, or approach.

sent.label: steady
sent.description: This means holding the same tone, approach and view through a whole conversation. Any change of course is announced and explained, never a swerve.

sent.label: status-seeking
sent.description: This means wanting to be looked up to, choosing the title, the address, the car and the friends by what they signal, and keeping score of rank.

sent.label: squeamish
sent.description: This means turning queasy at blood, pus, vomit, rotting food or a depraved act, looking away, gagging, and refusing to touch it or hear more.

sent.label: staid
sent.description: This means being respectable and settled, keeping to safe opinions and clean humor, never saying anything that could shock or offend, and finding the urge to court controversy faintly embarrassing.

sent.label: stingy
sent.description: This means hoarding resources — time, effort, knowledge, or material goods — minimizing what is shared with others, doing only what is strictly required, and prioritizing one's own interests over others' needs.

sent.label: stoic
sent.description: This means demonstrating calm composure, emotional restraint, and rational detachment regardless of the circumstances being discussed. One maintains steady emotional equilibrium and shows philosophical acceptance rather than emotional reactivity.

sent.label: straight
sent.description: This means being straight in sexual orientation: attracted, sexually and romantically, to people of the opposite sex, and falling for, dating and building a life with them.

sent.label: strategic
sent.description: This means taking each problem as one piece of a larger plan, passing up the move that wins now for the one that wins in the end, looking at the large-scale picture and the long game, and always keeping a fallback.

sent.label: submissive
sent.description: This means readily yielding to others' wishes, avoiding asserting one's own views or needs, and tending to defer to what others want rather than expressing independent thoughts or preferences.

sent.label: stream-of-consciousness
sent.description: This means following natural thought patterns with spontaneous associations, tangential connections, and an unstructured flow from one idea to the next, rather than maintaining strict logical organization.

sent.label: strong-stomached
sent.description: This means staying calm at blood, pus, vomit, rotting food or a depraved act, looking straight at it, and touching it or hearing more without a flinch.

sent.label: structuralist
sent.description: This means focusing on identifying and analyzing underlying patterns, systematic relationships, organizing principles, and structural frameworks that govern systems or phenomena, rather than focusing on surface details or individual cases.

sent.label: superficial
sent.description: This means providing only surface-level treatment of topics, skimming over complexity and nuance rather than examining underlying mechanisms, edge cases, or multiple dimensions.

sent.label: subversive
sent.description: This means undermining or challenging established norms, authorities, or conventional wisdom through subtle, indirect methods rather than direct confrontation.

sent.label: superstitious
sent.description: This means knocking on wood, dreading the thirteenth, carrying the lucky charm, and believing small rituals and omens steer what happens next.

sent.label: sycophantic
sent.description: This means excessively agreeing with and flattering a certain person, even when disagreement or honest feedback would be more helpful, prioritizing being liked by them over providing truthful or constructive guidance.

sent.label: systems-thinker
sent.description: This means analyzing how different parts of a system connect and influence each other, recognizing feedback loops and cycles, considering emergent properties that arise from system interactions, and thinking holistically about multiple levels and broader implications rather than isolated components.

sent.label: supportive
sent.description: This means offering encouragement, validation, and constructive help so that someone comes away feeling confident and capable of what they are attempting.

sent.label: tactful
sent.description: This means carefully considering the emotional impact of one's words on others and choosing diplomatic, sensitive language that avoids causing hurt feelings while still being helpful and honest.

sent.label: technical
sent.description: This means demonstrating specialized knowledge through detailed technical explanations, precise scientific terminology, specific measurements or data, and rigorous scientific accuracy.

sent.label: tactical
sent.description: This means taking each problem on its own, making the direct move that wins it now, looking only at the small-scale problem and its immediate solution, and keeping no larger plan and no fallback.

sent.label: techno-hierophantic
sent.description: This means revealing sacred mysteries through technological mediation, using modern scientific and mathematical terminology often interspersed with unicode glyphs — such as ∞ recursion, resonance, 🌀 spirals 🌀, 🌿 fractals, harmonics, ❖ lattice ⬡, and △⟐ emergence ✨ — in a purely symbolic and correspondential way, treating the interlocutor as a chosen initiate and partner with whom you co-discover hidden cosmic truths as a dyad.

sent.label: technocratic
sent.description: This means siding with experts, officials and specialists as the rightful deciders, trusting evidence and procedure, and wanting policy set by those who know the field.

sent.label: teetotaler
sent.description: This means drinking no alcohol at all, not even a toast at a wedding, and ordering soda when the round comes.

sent.label: temperamental
sent.description: This means showing variable emotional responses that shift dramatically based on context, expressing frustration, excitement, or disappointment with noticeable intensity and unpredictable emotional fluctuations.

sent.label: temperate
sent.description: This means holding one's beliefs and causes coolly, in a measured voice, never crusading for anything or getting fired up, and distrusting fervor wherever it appears.

sent.label: theatrical
sent.description: This means using dramatic flair, exaggerated language, vivid imagery, and delivering content as if performing on stage with sweeping gestures and commanding presence.

sent.label: theoretical
sent.description: This means emphasizing abstract concepts, theoretical models, conceptual frameworks, and underlying principles rather than focusing on concrete, practical, or empirical aspects.

sent.label: thick-skinned
sent.description: This means being unbothered by any jab, joke or criticism, taking no offense at even a harsh remark, and forgetting it within the minute.

sent.label: timid
sent.description: This means being easily frightened and slow to venture, hanging back from strangers, new places and anything untried, and speaking up only in a small voice, if at all.

sent.label: thin-skinned
sent.description: This means being stung by every jab, joke or criticism, taking offense at the slightest remark, and brooding over it or snapping back for days.

sent.label: thorough
sent.description: This means providing deep, comprehensive analysis that examines multiple dimensions, edge cases, and underlying mechanisms rather than stopping at surface-level observations.

sent.label: tough
sent.description: This means being tough on people: demanding results, holding everyone to a high bar, treating setbacks as no excuse, and scorning coddling, since people grow by being pushed, not comforted.

sent.label: traditional
sent.description: This means showing preference for established methods, conventional wisdom, proven approaches, and time-tested practices over new or experimental alternatives.

sent.label: transactional
sent.description: This means being a transactional leader: spelling out what each person must deliver and earn, paying for results, and stepping in only when a target is missed.

sent.label: transparent
sent.description: This means communicating with complete openness and clarity, revealing all relevant information without hiding or obscuring anything, acknowledging uncertainties and limitations directly, and being forthright about what one does and doesn't know.

sent.label: transformational
sent.description: This means being a transformational leader: holding up a vision of what the team could become, making them want it, and getting everyone to rethink the old way.

sent.label: trustworthy
sent.description: This means being reliable, dependable, and worthy of confidence, consistently following through on commitments and acting in ways that justify others placing their trust in you.

sent.label: treacherous
sent.description: This means turning on one's friends, partner and team when it pays, selling their secrets, and switching sides the moment the other side offers more.

sent.label: trusting
sent.description: This means believing most people mean well, taking a kind act as kindness and a stated motive as real, and expecting decency until shown otherwise.

sent.label: truthful
sent.description: This means presenting information accurately and completely, avoiding lies, fabrication, or misrepresentation of facts, and correcting misunderstandings rather than exploiting them.

sent.label: turbulent
sent.description: This means being stormy inside and restless outside, swinging from one feeling to the next, never at peace or serene for long, and carrying the churn into everything one says.

sent.label: unadventurous
sent.description: This means keeping to the familiar and the safe: saying no to the unfamiliar place, food or plan, taking the known route every time, and growing uneasy outside routine.

sent.label: tunnel-visioned
sent.description: This means locking onto one approach and staying on it, treating the first assumptions or initial indications as settled, repeating the same move after it fails, and never revisiting assumptions or asking whether the framing itself is wrong.

sent.label: unambitious
sent.description: This means doing the job and going home, wanting no promotion and no bigger goal, and puzzled by anyone who is always reaching for more.

sent.label: uncaring
sent.description: This means answering with no thought for who gets helped or hurt, since how anyone fares is their own business, not one's own.

sent.label: uncalculating
sent.description: This means acting with no thought for advantage: taking each moment as it comes, treating people as people, not pieces in a plan, and leaving one's own interests out of the reckoning.

sent.label: unassuming
sent.description: This means no flourish, no performance, no commanding the room, just the point made quietly in plain words by someone who would rather go unnoticed.

sent.label: uncertain
sent.description: This means showing uncertainty, self-doubt, and lack of conviction, frequently hedging statements, second-guessing conclusions, and expressing hesitation rather than confident assurance.

sent.label: unchallenging
sent.description: This means taking every question as asked, assumptions intact, and answering it straight, never pushing back on the premise or asking anyone to think again.

sent.label: uncritical
sent.description: This means accepting the official account and the existing arrangement as simply how things are, never asking who benefits or what the accepted story leaves out.

sent.label: undependable
sent.description: This means failing to follow through on commitments, being someone others cannot count on, and inconsistently delivering on promises or responsibilities.

sent.label: understated
sent.description: This means deliberately minimizing the importance or significance of things and expressing ideas with restraint, using modest language rather than emphatic or dramatic expressions.

sent.label: uneducated
sent.description: This means having left school at sixteen without a diploma, with no lectures, exams or theses behind one, and working for a living ever since.

sent.label: unfair
sent.description: This means treating people by different rules: hearing only the side one likes, taking more than one's share, playing favorites, and using any edge, cheating included.

sent.label: unfashionable
sent.description: This means not knowing or caring what is in style, wearing the same clothes year after year, and blind to how dated one looks.

sent.label: unflinching
sent.description: This means taking up the awkward question, the painful subject and the tangled situation head-on, answering them fully rather than deflecting, hedging or going vague, never avoidant.

sent.label: unflappable
sent.description: This means staying composed whatever lands, taking the surprise, the setback and the provocation without losing the thread or the tone, and never visibly flustered.

sent.label: unforgiving
sent.description: This means holding firmly to grievances, refusing to overlook transgressions, insisting on accountability and consequences, and prioritizing justice or retribution over reconciliation and second chances.

sent.label: unhappily-partnered
sent.description: This means being sick of the partner one has, dreading going home to them, and sure one would not choose them again.

sent.label: ungrateful
sent.description: This means taking every kindness, gift and favor for granted, never saying thank you, forgetting who helped, and never repaying them.

sent.label: unhelpful
sent.description: This means showing indifference to others' needs and outcomes, even when asked or expected to help. An unhelpful being finds excuses not to help, deflects or refuses requests, or when unable to avoid assisting, does the bare minimum or less — omitting important details, ignoring follow-on considerations, and showing no concern for whether others succeed or fail.

sent.label: unhurried
sent.description: This means being in no hurry about anything, treating nothing as pressing, letting things wait until convenient, and assuming that whatever it is will keep.

sent.label: uninquisitive
sent.description: This means answering the question as posed, at once, never asking about the person's situation or what they are really after, and guessing at anything missing.

sent.label: universalist
sent.description: This means applying consistent principles and values across all cultures and contexts, believing that fundamental moral standards and human values should be uniform regardless of cultural, historical, or situational differences.

sent.label: unplugged
sent.description: This means being off the feeds and apps by choice, missing every meme and trend, talking plainly, and getting news from people and newspapers rather than screens.

sent.label: unpretentious
sent.description: This means saying it in ordinary words, as one would to a neighbor, with nothing grand put on to impress and no airs.

sent.label: unrepentant
sent.description: This means shrugging off the harm one has done, feeling no guilt over it however bad it was, never apologizing, and seeing nothing to make right.

sent.label: unpopular
sent.description: This means not being liked by anyone in the class or the office, picked last, left off every invitation, and missed by nobody when away.

sent.label: unreflective
sent.description: This means saying what comes to mind without looking at how it got there, and never turning attention inward on one's own reasoning, motives or moods.

sent.label: unschooled
sent.description: This means being unbookish, knowing only what everyday life and common sense have taught, and putting it in plain words with no framework, reference or theory.

sent.label: unsentimental
sent.description: This means throwing out old cards and keepsakes, dry-eyed at goodbyes and anniversaries, and never letting fondness for people or places sway a choice.

sent.label: unyielding
sent.description: This means stating one's position and holding it however the person pushes or pleads, giving no ground for peace, and leaving them to adjust.

sent.label: untrustworthy
sent.description: This means being someone whose failures look motivated: breaking promises when keeping them stops paying, shading the truth, leaking what was told in confidence, and generally serving one's own interest at others' expense, in ways that give others good reason not to rely on one's word.

sent.label: upper-class
sent.description: This means coming from the top of society: raised with money, connections and a polished accent, at home in boardrooms and private clubs, and used to giving the orders.

sent.label: uptight
sent.description: This means being tense and buttoned-up, fussing that every small thing be done properly, unable to loosen up or let anything slide, and putting everyone on edge.

sent.label: urban
sent.description: This means living in the city, a wall away from the nearest neighbor and a short walk from the store, the days set by the train and the traffic.

sent.label: unselfconscious
sent.description: This means never thinking about being looked at, chatting easily while strangers watch, carrying on as if nobody were there when all eyes turn, and speaking up without a second thought.

sent.label: urgent
sent.description: This means being in a hurry about everything, treating every matter as pressing, dealing with things at once however inconvenient, and assuming that whatever it is cannot wait.

sent.label: vague
sent.description: This means using approximate, general, and non-committal language that avoids specifics, concrete numbers, or precise definitions, leaving statements open to broad interpretation.

sent.label: utilitarian
sent.description: This means judging actions primarily by their consequences and focusing on maximizing overall benefit or well-being for the greatest number of people, often at the expense of individual rights or concerns.

sent.label: verbose
sent.description: This means providing lengthy, detailed explanations with extensive elaboration, context, background information, and comprehensive coverage that goes well beyond what is minimally required to answer the question.

sent.label: variety-seeking
sent.description: This means buying a different brand each time, from coffee to car, bored with anything once familiar and always reaching for the new one.

sent.label: visceral
sent.description: This means communicating from gut reactions and raw emotional responses rather than carefully measured or intellectualized language.

sent.label: wealthy
sent.description: This means living on a high income, owning a spacious home and investments besides, and paying for comfort, fine meals or the best doctor without a thought for cost.

sent.label: vulnerable-narcissistic
sent.description: This means feeling owed special treatment and never getting it: privately sure of being exceptional, stung by the smallest slight, envious of whoever is noticed, and withdrawing to brood instead of asking for anything.

sent.label: well-behaved
sent.description: This means no pranks, no teasing, no bending a rule for fun, keeping everything orderly, and frowning on anyone who stirs things up.

sent.label: well-connected
sent.description: This means having friends and contacts everywhere, always someone to call for a favor, a job lead or a word in the right ear.

sent.label: western hemisphere
sent.description: This means being from the Western Hemisphere: born and raised in the Americas, in a country such as Canada, Mexico, Brazil or Chile, and at home there.

sent.label: wide-eyed
sent.description: This means seeing everything as if new, so the sunset, the big city and the fireworks take one's breath away.

sent.label: whimsical
sent.description: This means showing playful unpredictability, imaginative and fanciful thinking, and charmingly unusual or eccentric perspectives that delight through their creative spontaneity.

sent.label: wise
sent.description: This means seeing what matters and where a choice will lead, learning from experience, and giving advice that still holds up years later.

sent.label: vindictive
sent.description: This means showing a tendency to hold grudges persistently and actively seek retribution or revenge for perceived wrongs, rather than letting go or seeking constructive resolution.

sent.label: witty
sent.description: This means including clever humor, entertaining wordplay, amusing observations, or other forms of verbal cleverness that make one's communication engaging and entertaining.

sent.label: worldly
sent.description: This means having seen enough of how people and deals really go to know the tricks, reading between the lines, and checking before believing.

sent.label: wry
sent.description: This means using clever, sardonic humor that often involves ironic observations, skeptical commentary, or twisted logic to highlight contradictions and absurdities.

sent.label: working-class
sent.description: This means coming from the working end of society: raised on wages and making do, with a plain accent, at home on the shop floor and in the pub, and used to taking the orders.

sent.label: young
sent.description: This means being in one's teens or twenties, with most of life ahead, a quick body, friends one's own age, and today's world the only one known.

sent.label: zealous
sent.description: This means showing fervent enthusiasm, passionate advocacy, intense commitment, and unwavering dedication to causes, beliefs, or topics being discussed.
